seo.title: Best Natural Wine Bars in Bangkok (2026) | tabiji.ai
seo.metaDescription: Explore Bangkok's thriving natural wine scene! Discover top natural wine bars for unique biodynamic selections, delicious food pairings, and vibrant atmospheres.

hero.h1: 12 Best Natural Wine Bars in Bangkok
hero.subtitle: Bangkok's culinary landscape is continuously evolving, with a growing appreciation for sustainable and artisanal products. Natural wine, with its minimal intervention philosophy, has found a passionate following here, leading to a flourishing scene of dedicated bars and restaurants.

picks.name: Mother Wine
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Mother Wine is widely considered the pioneer of the natural wine movement in Bangkok. This cozy, minimalist bar offers an exceptional, ever-changing selection of biodynamic and organic wines, served by passionate and knowledgeable staff. It's the perfect spot to discover new labels in a relaxed setting.
picks.whatToOrder: Ask the sommelier for a bespoke flight based on your preferences, paired with their charcuterie and cheese board.
picks.insiderTip: Seating is limited, especially on weekends. Arrive early or make a reservation if you're with a group.
picks.redditQuote: "Mother Wine truly is the OG of natural wine in Bangkok. Their staff know their stuff, and I always leave having tried something new and amazing."

picks.name: JUA
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Nestled in a historic shophouse, JUA offers a vibrant izakaya experience with a strong focus on natural wines and sake. Their expertly grilled kushiyaki (skewers) and small Japanese plates are perfectly designed to complement their extensive, hand-picked wine list. It's a lively spot with a great atmosphere.
picks.whatToOrder: Assorted Yakitori Skewers and the seasonal specials, paired with a glass of orange wine from their curated list.
picks.insiderTip: The bar seating offers a great view of the open kitchen and charcoal grill – perfect for solo diners or couples.
picks.redditQuote: "JUA has such a cool vibe, and their natural wine selection is seriously impressive for an izakaya. The food is top-notch too!"

picks.name: Mitr Bar
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Mitr Bar, meaning 'friend' in Thai, lives up to its name with a welcoming, unpretentious atmosphere. This popular Ari spot is known for its accessible selection of natural wines and delicious, creative Thai-inspired small plates. It's a great place to unwind after work or enjoy a casual evening with friends.
picks.whatToOrder: Crispy Pork Belly with Spicy Sauce and a glass of pét-nat (pétillant naturel) for a refreshing pairing.
picks.insiderTip: Check their Instagram for daily wine specials and pop-up events, which often feature guest chefs or unique wine flights.
picks.redditQuote: "Mitr Bar is my go-to for natural wine in Ari. Prices are reasonable, and their Thai snacks are surprisingly good with the wines."

picks.name: The Lasting Som
picks.whyItMadeTheList: More than just a bar, The Lasting Som is a dedicated natural wine shop and tasting room. Their shelves are lined with an impressive collection from around the world, available for retail or to enjoy on-site for a corkage fee. It’s an ideal place for serious natural wine enthusiasts to explore and learn.
picks.whatToOrder: Pick a bottle from their extensive retail selection and enjoy it with one of their curated cheese and charcuterie platters.
picks.insiderTip: Don't hesitate to ask the staff for recommendations; they are incredibly knowledgeable and can guide you through their diverse inventory.
picks.redditQuote: "If you're serious about natural wine, The Lasting Som is a must-visit. It’s like a library of deliciousness, and the staff are super helpful."

picks.name: Cultivate Cafe & Bar
picks.whyItMadeTheList: By day, Cultivate is a charming cafe; by night, it transforms into a cozy bar with a thoughtfully curated natural wine list. They focus on small-batch producers and offer a relaxed atmosphere perfect for a low-key evening. Their comfort food menu perfectly complements the rustic wine selections.
picks.whatToOrder: Their daily pasta special paired with a light-bodied natural red wine.
picks.insiderTip: They often host 'winemaker spotlight' events – check their social media for upcoming dates to meet producers and try exclusive bottles.
picks.redditQuote: "Cultivate is such a chill spot. Great coffee in the morning and their natural wine selection is surprisingly good for a cafe that transitions to a bar."

picks.name: Moda Bistro
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Moda Bistro elevates Italian dining with an exquisite natural wine list that perfectly complements its modern Mediterranean menu. The elegant yet unpretentious setting makes it ideal for a special occasion or a sophisticated dinner. Their pasta and seafood dishes shine alongside their biodynamic selections.
picks.whatToOrder: Handmade Pasta dish of the day and ask for a natural wine pairing suggestion from their sommelier.
picks.insiderTip: Make a reservation, especially if you're planning to visit on a weekend. Their outdoor seating area is lovely on cooler evenings.
picks.redditQuote: "Moda Bistro isn't just great Italian food; their natural wine list is surprisingly extensive and the sommelier really knows their stuff."

picks.name: Smalls
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Smalls is a Bangkok institution, known for its eclectic charm, excellent cocktails, and often live jazz or blues. While primarily a cocktail bar, they maintain a surprisingly good and adventurous natural wine list, offering a unique experience for wine lovers in a legendary, multi-story venue with a vibrant crowd.
picks.whatToOrder: A glass from their rotating natural wine selection, often featuring lesser-known regions, enjoyed with some French-inspired bar bites.
picks.insiderTip: Head up to the rooftop for a breath of fresh air and a different perspective, but don't miss the cozy nooks inside.
picks.redditQuote: "Smalls has such a vibe! Didn't expect to find such a cool natural wine list alongside their killer cocktails. Always a good time there."

picks.name: VIVIN Grocery
picks.priceRangeLocal: ฿500-1,000 / $15-30 per person (for a glass and light bites)
picks.whyItMadeTheList: VIVIN Grocery is a gourmet deli and grocer specializing in organic and artisanal products, including a commendable selection of natural wines. While primarily a retail space, their Thonglor branch offers seating where you can enjoy their wines by the glass alongside French cheeses, charcuterie, and gourmet sandwiches. It's a great spot for a casual afternoon tasting.
picks.whatToOrder: A glass of their natural rosé with a plate of locally sourced artisan cheeses and cold cuts.
picks.insiderTip: They often have tasting events or special promotions on natural wines. Follow their social media for updates.
picks.redditQuote: "VIVIN Grocery is my secret weapon for natural wine. Grab a bottle to go or enjoy a glass with some amazing cheese right there. So convenient!"

picks.name: A.R.O.N.
picks.whyItMadeTheList: A.R.O.N. (A Restaurant Of No Name) is a minimalist, chef-driven restaurant offering a refined Modern European menu. They focus on fresh, seasonal ingredients and complement their dishes with a carefully curated wine list that prominently features natural and biodynamic selections. It's a culinary journey with thoughtful wine pairings.
picks.whatToOrder: Opt for the tasting menu with the natural wine pairing option for a complete experience.
picks.insiderTip: The menu changes frequently based on seasonal availability, so there's always something new to try.
picks.redditQuote: "A.R.O.N. is a hidden gem in Phrom Phong. Their food is incredible, and I was so happy to see a strong natural wine presence on their list."

picks.name: Kiki's Bistro
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Kiki's Bistro brings a touch of Parisian charm to Thonglor with its classic French fare and an impressive, well-rounded wine list that includes a strong emphasis on natural and organic options. It's a delightful spot for traditional French dishes paired with unconventional yet delicious wines, offering a cozy and romantic atmosphere.
picks.whatToOrder: Steak Frites with a robust natural Cabernet Franc or a natural Beaujolais.
picks.insiderTip: They often have special 'wine discovery' evenings where you can sample wines from specific regions or producers.
picks.redditQuote: "Was surprised to find some really interesting natural wines at Kiki's Bistro. Great place for a date night with excellent French food."

picks.name: Empty Plates
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Empty Plates offers an intimate and experimental tasting menu experience in a minimalist setting. While their food is the star, their beverage program includes a carefully selected list of natural wines, chosen to complement the innovative dishes. It's a place for adventurous eaters and wine drinkers looking for a unique, curated journey.
picks.whatToOrder: The full tasting menu with the optional natural wine pairing, designed to elevate each course.
picks.insiderTip: Reservations are essential due to their limited seating and often booked-out schedule. Plan weeks in advance.
picks.redditQuote: "Empty Plates blew me away! The tasting menu was amazing, and their natural wine pairings were spot on. A truly unique experience in Chinatown."

picks.name: Konkord
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Konkord is a chic yet approachable bistro that has quickly become a local favorite for its inventive European cuisine and thoughtful wine program. Their natural wine selection is diverse, featuring bottles from various regions that are approachable for newcomers and interesting for seasoned enthusiasts. It’s perfect for a relaxed dinner or a lively evening with friends.
picks.whatToOrder: Their signature Konkord Burger with a glass of crisp, natural white wine or an amber (orange) wine.
picks.insiderTip: They have a lovely outdoor seating area perfect for people-watching in the Sathorn area.
picks.redditQuote: "Konkord is such a gem! Their food is delicious, and they have a surprisingly good list of natural wines that don't break the bank."

faq.question: What exactly is natural wine?
faq.answer: Natural wine is made with minimal intervention in both the vineyard and the cellar. This typically means grapes are organically or biodynamically farmed, fermentation occurs with native yeasts, and there are no or very few additives (like sulfur dioxide) used during winemaking. The result is often a more vibrant, unfiltered, and expressive wine.

faq.question: Is natural wine more expensive than regular wine in Bangkok?
faq.answer: Generally, natural wines can be slightly more expensive due to their artisanal production methods, smaller batch sizes, and often organic/biodynamic farming costs. However, many bars in Bangkok, like Mitr Bar, offer approachable options, and the price difference is becoming less significant as natural wine gains popularity.

faq.question: Can I find natural wine in Bangkok outside of dedicated bars?
faq.answer: Yes! While dedicated natural wine bars offer the widest selection, many high-end restaurants, gourmet delis like VIVIN Grocery, and even some specialty liquor stores now stock a variety of natural wines. Look for 'organic', 'biodynamic', or 'sulfur-free' labels, or ask a knowledgeable staff member for recommendations.

faq.question: What kind of food pairs best with natural wine?
faq.answer: Natural wines, with their diverse styles, can pair with a wide range of foods. Lighter, fruitier natural reds and orange wines often complement Southeast Asian and Japanese cuisine beautifully, while crisp whites and pét-nats are fantastic with seafood or lighter European fare. Don't be afraid to experiment, as the lower intervention often makes them more food-friendly.

faq.question: Are natural wines always cloudy or fizzy?
faq.answer: Not necessarily! While some natural wines are intentionally left unfiltered (which can give them a cloudy appearance) or are pét-nats (naturally sparkling), many are clear and still. The diverse styles of natural winemaking mean you can find everything from crisp, clean whites to robust, age-worthy reds that look and feel similar to conventional wines.

faq.question: What is the best neighborhood for natural wine bars in Bangkok?
faq.answer: The neighborhoods of Phrom Phong and Thonglor, often referred to as Bangkok's 'Ekkamai-Thonglor' area, are currently the hotspots for natural wine. These areas boast a high concentration of trendy bars and restaurants, many of which have embraced the natural wine movement, making them ideal for a wine-hopping evening.

methodology: Our selection for the Best Natural Wine Bars in Bangkok was curated by a team of local experts and seasoned food & travel writers. We focused on venues offering a dedicated natural wine list, knowledgeable staff, unique ambiance, and a compelling food menu that complements the wine selection. Venues were personally visited or thoroughly vetted through recent reviews and local recommendations to ensure accuracy.
